let preview text =
  let len = String.length text in
  if len <= 2048 then text
  else
    String.sub text 0 1024 ^ "\n...[truncated]...\n"
    ^ String.sub text (len - 1024) 1024

                                                                           
                                                                       
let log_relocation_candidates db (a : Internal_types.anchor) ~doc_revision
    ~anchor_norm ~query_shingles ~minimum_hits ~rejected candidates =
  let document_name doc_id =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | None -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id ^ " (missing)"
    | Some meta ->
        sprintf "%s source=%S path=%S revision=%d"
          (App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id)
          (App_types.Source.to_string meta.source_doc.source)
          meta.source_doc.locator meta.revision
  in
  let anchor_id = App_types.Anchor_id.to_string a.anchor_id in
  let original = List.find_opt (fun c -> c.doc_id = a.doc_id) candidates in
  let selected = List.nth_opt candidates 0 in
  let name = function
    | None -> "none"
    | Some c -> document_name c.doc_id
  in
  Util.Log.printf
    "Anchor relocation %s before mutation\n\
     original_document=%s original_revision=%d original_range=B%d-%d\n\
     original_text_bytes=%d original_text_preview=%S\n\
     attempt_revision=%d unique_query_shingles=%d minimum_hits=%d \
     candidates=%d filtered_documents=%d\n\
     selection_policy=greatest matched query coverage; ties prefer more \
     inlier hits, then lowest document ID\n\
     original_document_preference=none\n\
     original_document_best=%s selected_destination=%s"
    anchor_id (document_name a.doc_id) a.doc_revision a.range.start
    a.range.end_
    (String.length a.raw_contents)
    (preview a.raw_contents) doc_revision query_shingles minimum_hits
    (List.length candidates) rejected (name original) (name selected);
  List.iteri
    (fun i candidate ->
      let reason =
        if i = 0 then
          "selected: greatest matched query coverage; deterministic tie \
           breaking"
        else "not selected: lower coverage or tie priority"
      in
      Util.Log.printf
        "Anchor relocation %s candidate-%d\n\
         document=%s original_document=%b matching_hits=%d document_hits=%d \
         meets_minimum_hits=true\n\
         coverage_bytes=%d normalized_anchor_bytes=%d coverage_fraction=%.6f\n\
         mode_offset=%d offset_tolerance=%d window=B%d-%d \
         predicted_range=B%d-%d\n\
         reason=%s"
        anchor_id (i + 1)
        (document_name candidate.doc_id)
        (candidate.doc_id = a.doc_id)
        candidate.num_hits candidate.document_hits candidate.coverage
        (String.length anchor_norm.text)
        (float_of_int candidate.coverage
        /. float_of_int (String.length anchor_norm.text))
        candidate.mode_offset match_offset_tolerance candidate.window.start
        candidate.window.end_ candidate.range.start candidate.range.end_
        reason)
    candidates;
  let inspect role = function
    | None -> Util.Log.printf "Anchor relocation %s %s=none" anchor_id role
    | Some c ->
        let text =
          String.sub c.contents c.range.start (c.range.end_ - c.range.start)
        in
        Util.Log.printf
          "Anchor relocation %s %s\n\
           document=%s target_revision=%d effective_range=B%d-%d \
           text_bytes=%d text_truncated=%b text_preview=%S\n\
           would_change_document=%b would_change_range=%b \
           would_change_contents=%b"
          anchor_id role (document_name c.doc_id) c.revision c.range.start
          c.range.end_ (String.length text)
          (String.length text > 2048)
          (preview text) (c.doc_id <> a.doc_id) (c.range <> a.range)
          (text <> a.raw_contents)
  in
  inspect "original_document_candidate" original;
  inspect "selected_destination" selected

                                                                           
                                                                            
let relocate_one db (a : Internal_types.anchor) ~doc_revision =
  let anchor_norm = normalize_whitespace a.raw_contents in
  let query_shingles, minimum_hits, rejected, candidates =
    find_candidates db a.raw_contents anchor_norm
  in
  log_relocation_candidates db a ~doc_revision ~anchor_norm ~query_shingles
    ~minimum_hits ~rejected candidates;
  match candidates with
  | [] ->
      DB.Anchors.mark_attempt_failed db a.anchor_id
        ~doc_revision_attempt:doc_revision;
      None
  | candidate :: _ ->
      let range = candidate.range in
      let raw_contents =
        String.sub candidate.contents range.start (range.end_ - range.start)
      in
      let changed =
        candidate.doc_id <> a.doc_id
        || range <> a.range
        || raw_contents <> a.raw_contents
      in
      let updated =
        {
          a with
          doc_id = candidate.doc_id;
          doc_revision = candidate.revision;
          doc_revision_attempt = candidate.revision;
          range;
          raw_contents;
          last_author = T.Algo;
        }
      in
      Util.Log.printf
        "Anchor relocation %s applying relocation: document=%s revision=%d \
         range=B%d-%d changed=%b; previous anchor content still intact"
        (App_types.Anchor_id.to_string a.anchor_id)
        (App_types.Doc_id.to_string candidate.doc_id)
        candidate.revision range.start range.end_ changed;
      DB.Anchors.relocate db updated;
      if changed then Some updated else None

let relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision : anchor list =
  DB.Anchors.get_stale db doc_id ~doc_revision
  |> List.filter_map (fun a -> relocate_one db a ~doc_revision)
  |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)

let add_anchor db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) ~expected_revision ~start ~end_ :
    anchor =
  if start < 0 || end_ < start then failwith "Invalid anchor range";
  if end_ - start > max_anchor_length then
    ksprintf failwith "Anchor is too long: must be at most %d bytes"
      max_anchor_length;
  let doc_meta = get_doc_meta_exn db src_doc in
                                                                       
                            
  if expected_revision <> doc_meta.revision then
    ksprintf failwith
      "Document %s is at revision %d, not %d as expected: it has been \
       reindexed since that revision. Look up its current contents and \
       revision again before creating an anchor."
      (App_types.Src_doc.show_source_doc doc_meta.source_doc)
      doc_meta.revision expected_revision;
  let contents = text_source.contents in
  if end_ > String.length contents then
    failwith "Anchor range is out of bounds";
                                                                  
  let start, end_ = Util.Text.safe_range contents ~start ~end_ in
                                                                             
                                                        
  if end_ - start < min_anchor_length then
    ksprintf failwith "Anchor is too short: must be at least %d bytes"
      min_anchor_length;
  let anchor_contents = String.sub contents start (end_ - start) in
  let normalized_length =
    String.length (normalize_whitespace anchor_contents).text
  in
  if normalized_length < min_anchor_length then
    ksprintf failwith
      "Anchor is too short: after collapsing whitespace, must be at least %d \
       byte(s), got %d"
      min_anchor_length normalized_length;
  let range = { T.start; end_ } in
  let new_anchor : Internal_types.anchor =
    {
                                                              
      anchor_id = App_types.Anchor_id.of_int_exn 0;
      doc_id = doc_meta.doc_id;
      doc_revision = doc_meta.revision;
      doc_revision_attempt = doc_meta.revision;
      acknowledged_revision = None;
      range;
      raw_contents = anchor_contents;
      last_author = T.Agent;
    }
  in
  DB.Anchors.create db new_anchor |> to_public_anchor db

let delete_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : unit =
  DB.Anchors.delete db anchor_id

let get_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : anchor option =

let get_anchors db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t) ~start ~end_ : anchor list
    =
  let doc_meta = get_doc_meta_exn db src_doc in
  DB.Anchors.get_overlapping db doc_meta.doc_id ~start ~end_
  |> List.map (to_public_anchor db)

let get_all_anchors db : anchor list =

let get_all_current_anchors db : anchor list =

let get_all_anchors_needing_review db : anchor list =

let acknowledge_anchor db (anchor_id : T.anchor_id) : anchor =
  let a =
    match DB.Anchors.get db anchor_id with
    | Some a -> a
    | None ->
        ksprintf failwith "No such anchor: %s"
          (App_types.Anchor_id.to_string anchor_id)
  in
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db a.doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None ->
        failwith "internal error: anchor references a nonexistent document"
  in
  DB.Anchors.acknowledge db anchor_id ~revision:doc_meta.revision;
  match get_anchor db anchor_id with
  | Some a -> a
  | None -> failwith "internal error: anchor disappeared during acknowledge"

type search_result = {
  doc_id : doc_id;
  source_doc : T.source_doc;
  range : T.range;
  raw_contents : string;
  num_hits : int;
  coverage : int;
  source : Util.Text_source.t;
}

let search db snippet : search_result list =
  let anchor_norm = normalize_whitespace snippet in
  if String.length anchor_norm.text < min_query_length then
    ksprintf failwith
      "Query snippet is too short: after collapsing whitespace, must be at \
       least %d byte(s)"
      min_query_length;
  let _, _, _, candidates = find_candidates db snippet anchor_norm in
  List.map
    (fun (candidate : candidate) ->
      let meta = Option.get (DB.Documents.get_by_id db candidate.doc_id) in
      {
        doc_id = candidate.doc_id;
        source_doc = meta.source_doc;
        range = candidate.range;
        raw_contents =
          String.sub candidate.contents candidate.range.start
            (candidate.range.end_ - candidate.range.start);
        num_hits = candidate.num_hits;
        coverage = candidate.coverage;
        source =
          {
            Util.Text_source.name = meta.source_doc.locator;
            contents = candidate.contents;
          };
      })
    candidates
  let full =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        Option.bind
          (DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
             source_doc.locator) (fun (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
            DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db meta.doc_id)
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_full_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match full with
  | None ->
      let ref_str =
        match doc_ref with
        | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
        | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
      in
      ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Deleted) ->
      ksprintf failwith
        "Document %s was deleted (see 'skl text document put' to re-add it)"
        (App_types.Src_doc.show_source_doc doc_meta.source_doc)
  | Some (doc_meta, DB.Active contents) ->
      ( doc_meta,
        { Util.Text_source.name = doc_meta.source_doc.locator; contents } )

                                                                   
                                                                 
                                                              
let reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~(contents : DB.doc_contents) :
    doc_meta * anchor list =
  DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_id;
  DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id ~contents ~force:false;
  (match contents with
  | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id c
  | DB.Deleted -> ());
  let doc_meta =
    match DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id with
    | Some m -> m
    | None -> failwith "internal error: just-registered document not found"
  in
  let changed =
    Anchor.relocate_stale_anchors db ~doc_id ~doc_revision:doc_meta.revision
  in
  (doc_meta, changed)

let add_file db (src_doc : App_types.Src_doc.t)
    (text_source : Util.Text_source.t) : doc_meta * anchor list =
  let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      ensure_source_declared db source_doc.source;
      let doc_id =
        DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:source_doc.source
          ~locator:source_doc.locator
          ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents)
      in
      DB.Containers.index db ~doc_id src_doc;
      reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id
        ~contents:(DB.Active text_source.contents))

let remove_document ?(strict = false) db (doc_ref : doc_ref) : anchor list =
  let doc_meta =
    match doc_ref with
    | By_locator src_doc ->
        let source_doc = App_types.Src_doc.to_source_doc src_doc in
        DB.Documents.get_by_locator db ~source:source_doc.source
          source_doc.locator
    | By_id doc_id -> DB.Documents.get_by_id db doc_id
  in
  match doc_meta with
  | None ->
      if strict then
        let ref_str =
          match doc_ref with
          | By_locator src_doc -> App_types.Src_doc.show src_doc
          | By_id doc_id -> App_types.Doc_id.to_string doc_id
        in
        ksprintf failwith "Not indexed: %s" ref_str
      else []
  | Some (meta : T.doc_meta) ->
      Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
          let doc_id =
            DB.Documents.create_or_update db ~source:meta.source_doc.source
              ~locator:meta.source_doc.locator ~contents:DB.Deleted
          in
          DB.Containers.delete_for_doc db doc_id;
          snd (reindex_and_relocate db ~doc_id ~contents:DB.Deleted))

                                                                               
let reindex_all db : int =
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_transaction db (fun () ->
      let docs = DB.Documents.get_all db in
      List.iter
        (fun ((doc_meta : T.doc_meta), contents) ->
          DB.Shingles.delete_doc db doc_meta.doc_id;
          DB.Documents_fuzzy.index db ~doc_id:doc_meta.doc_id ~contents
            ~force:true;
          match contents with
          | DB.Active c -> Anchor.index_shingles db ~doc_id:doc_meta.doc_id c
          | DB.Deleted ->                                          ())
        docs;
      List.length docs)

module U = Sqlite_util.Query

let source = Option.get (App_types.Source.of_string_opt "files:anchor-tests")
let src locator = App_types.Src_doc.of_source_doc_exn { source; locator }
let snapshot path contents = { Util.Text_source.name = path; contents }

let put db path contents =
  fst (Text.add_file db (src path) (snapshot path contents))

let with_db f =
  Sqlite_util.Connect.with_connection Memory (fun db ->
      Text.create_tables db;
      Text.put_source db source;
      f db)

let unique_text n =
  let state = Random.State.make [| 421 |] in
  String.init n (fun _ ->
      Char.chr (Char.code 'A' + Random.State.int state 26))

let anchor db text =
  ignore (put db "original.ml" text);
  Text.add_anchor db (src "original.ml")
    (snapshot "original.ml" text)
    ~expected_revision:0 ~start:0 ~end_:(String.length text)

let current db a = Option.get (Text.get_anchor db a.Text.anchor_id)

let relocate db query target check =
  let a = anchor db query in
  ignore (put db "destination.ml" target);
  ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
  let a = current db a in
  Testo.check Testo.string "destination.ml" a.source_doc.locator;
  Testo.check Testo.bool true
    (match a.status with
    | Text.Up_to_date _ -> true
    | _ -> false);
  Testo.check Testo.string
    (String.sub target a.range.start (a.range.end_ - a.range.start))
    a.raw_contents;
  check a

let stored_offsets db shingle =
  U.query_rows db
    "SELECT start FROM shingles WHERE shingle = ? ORDER BY start"
    [ U.Blob shingle ] ~f:(fun stmt -> Sqlite3.column_int stmt 0)

let tests =
  Testo.categorize "anchor alignment"
    [
      Testo.create "CABCDE does not stop the ABCDE match at AB" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 160 in
              let c = String.sub query 64 32 in
              let target = c ^ query in
              relocate db query target (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents;
                  Testo.check Testo.int 32 a.range.start;
                  Testo.check Testo.int 192 a.range.end_)));
      Testo.create
        "query duplicate shingles are all ignored while unique context \
         survives" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let text = unique_text 160 in
              let repeat = String.sub text 32 32 in
              let query =
                String.sub text 0 64 ^ repeat ^ String.sub text 64 96
              in
              relocate db query
                ("prefix!!" ^ query ^ "suffix!!")
                (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents;
                  Testo.check Testo.int 8 a.range.start)));
      Testo.create
        "document indexing removes the first and every later duplicate"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let block = unique_text 32 in
              ignore (put db "repeated.ml" (block ^ block));
              List.iter
                (fun offset ->
                  Testo.check (Testo.list Testo.int) []
                    (stored_offsets db (String.sub block offset 16)))
                [ 0; 8; 16 ];
              Testo.check (Testo.list Testo.int) [ 24 ]
                (stored_offsets db (String.sub (block ^ block) 24 16))));
      Testo.create "one isolated hit cannot relocate a long query" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 160 in
              let a = anchor db query in
              ignore
                (put db "weak.ml"
                   (String.sub query 0 16 ^ String.make 144 'z'));
              ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
              let a = current db a in
              Testo.check Testo.bool true (a.status = Text.Outdated);
              Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents;
              Testo.check Testo.string "original.ml" a.source_doc.locator));
      Testo.create "no unique query shingles leaves the anchor stale"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = String.make 80 'A' in
              let a = anchor db query in
              ignore (put db "destination.ml" query);
              ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
              let a = current db a in
              Testo.check Testo.bool true (a.status = Text.Outdated);
              Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents));
      Testo.create "a single unique 16-byte query can still match" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 16 in
              relocate db query
                (String.make 8 'z' ^ query)
                (fun a -> Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents)));
      Testo.create
        "modal offset rejects a distant outlier and trims unmatched query \
         prefix" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 224 in
              let suffix = String.sub query 32 192 in
              let target =
                String.sub query 0 32 ^ String.make 1600 'z' ^ suffix
              in
              relocate db query target (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.int 1632 a.range.start;
                  Testo.check Testo.string suffix a.raw_contents)));
      Testo.create
        "byte alignment spans whitespace reformatting and inserted text"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query =
                "alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf hotel india \
                 juliet kilo lima mike november oscar papa quebec romeo \
                 sierra tango uniform victor whiskey xray yankee zulu"
              in
              let target =
                String.sub query 0 70 ^ " \tnew\n "
                ^ String.sub query 70 (String.length query - 70)
              in
              relocate db query
                ("prefix!!" ^ target ^ "suffix!!")
                (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.string target a.raw_contents;
                  Testo.check Testo.int 8 a.range.start)));
      Testo.create "local alignment drops nonmatching extremities" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let middle = unique_text 160 in
              let query = "xxxxxxxx" ^ middle ^ "xxxxxxxx" in
              relocate db query
                ("zzzzzzzz" ^ middle ^ "zzzzzzzz")
                (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.string middle a.raw_contents;
                  Testo.check Testo.int 8 a.range.start)));
      Testo.create "the adjusted half-match threshold rounds up" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 160 in
              ignore (put db "below.ml" (String.sub query 0 80));
              ignore (put db "enough.ml" (String.sub query 0 88));
              let results = Text.search db query in
              Testo.check (Testo.list Testo.string) [ "enough.ml" ]
                (List.map
                   (fun (r : Text.search_result) -> r.source_doc.locator)
                   results);
              Testo.check Testo.int 10 (List.hd results).num_hits));
      Testo.create "modal tolerance includes 500 bytes and excludes 501"
        (fun () ->
          List.iter
            (fun distance ->
              with_db (fun db ->
                  let query = unique_text 160 in
                  let target =
                    String.sub query 0 80 ^ String.make distance 'z'
                    ^ String.sub query 80 80
                  in
                  ignore (put db "target.ml" target);
                  let result = List.hd (Text.search db query) in
                  if distance = 500 then
                    Testo.check Testo.bool true (result.coverage >= 140)
                  else Testo.check Testo.bool true (result.coverage <= 80)))
            [ 500; 501 ]);
      Testo.create
        "huge raw whitespace spans cannot create an unbounded alignment \
         window" (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = "abcdefgh ijklmno" in
              let a = anchor db query in
              ignore
                (put db "destination.ml"
                   ("abcdefgh" ^ String.make 50_000 ' ' ^ "ijklmno"));
              ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
              Testo.check Testo.bool true
                ((current db a).status = Text.Outdated)));
      Testo.create "the most frequent offset can differ from the median"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let text = unique_text 384 in
                                                                       
                                                            
              let repeated = String.sub text 64 32 in
              let strong =
                String.sub text 0 64
                ^ String.concat "" (List.init 4 (fun _ -> repeated))
                ^ String.sub text 96 64
              in
              let suffix = String.sub text 160 224 in
              let query = strong ^ suffix in
              let scattered =
                List.init 7 (fun i ->
                    String.make 1600 'z' ^ String.sub suffix (i * 32) 32)
              in
              let target = strong ^ String.concat "" scattered in
              relocate db query target (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.int 0 a.range.start;
                  Testo.check Testo.string strong a.raw_contents)));
      Testo.create "equal modal frequencies choose the smallest signed offset"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 192 in
              let suffix = String.sub query 96 96 in
              let target =
                String.sub query 0 96 ^ String.make 1600 'z' ^ suffix
              in
              relocate db query target (fun a ->
                  Testo.check Testo.int 1696 a.range.start;
                  Testo.check Testo.string suffix a.raw_contents)));
      Testo.create
        "scattered hits cannot replace an anchor with a short fragment"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let query = unique_text 256 in
              let target =
                String.concat (String.make 1600 'z')
                  (List.init 4 (fun i -> String.sub query (i * 64) 64))
              in
              let original = anchor db query in
              ignore (put db "destination.ml" target);
              ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
              Testo.check Testo.bool true (Text.search db query = []);
              let a = current db original in
              Testo.check Testo.bool true (a.status = Text.Outdated);
              Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents;
              Testo.check Testo.bool true (a.range = original.range);
              Testo.check Testo.string "original.ml" a.source_doc.locator));
      Testo.create
        "a returned range must reach half the normalized anchor length \
         rounded up" (fun () ->
          List.iter
            (fun (query_length, match_length, accepted) ->
              with_db (fun db ->
                  let text = unique_text (query_length - 1) in
                  let query =
                    String.sub text 0 47 ^ " "
                    ^ String.sub text 47 (query_length - 48)
                  in
                  let fragment =
                    String.sub query 0 47 ^ String.make 100 ' '
                    ^ String.sub query 48 (match_length - 48)
                  in
                                                                                 
                                                                            
                  let target =
                    fragment ^ String.make 1600 'z' ^ String.sub query 200 32
                  in
                  let original = anchor db query in
                  ignore (put db "destination.ml" target);
                  ignore (put db "original.ml" "removed");
                  let results = Text.search db query in
                  Testo.check Testo.int
                    (if accepted then 1 else 0)
                    (List.length results);
                  let a = current db original in
                  if accepted then begin
                    Testo.check Testo.string "destination.ml"
                      a.source_doc.locator;
                    Testo.check Testo.string fragment a.raw_contents
                  end
                  else begin
                    Testo.check Testo.bool true (a.status = Text.Outdated);
                    Testo.check Testo.string query a.raw_contents
                  end))
            [
              (256, 127, false);
              (256, 128, true);
              (257, 128, false);
              (257, 129, true);
            ]);
      Testo.create
        "whitespace cannot inflate a weak scattered fragment into a match"
        (fun () ->
          with_db (fun db ->
              let text = unique_text 255 in
              let query =
                String.sub text 0 47 ^ " " ^ String.sub text 47 208
              in
              let inflated =
                String.sub query 0 47 ^ String.make 100 ' '
                ^ String.sub query 48 48

let is_continuation_byte c = Char.code c land 0b1100_0000 = 0b1000_0000

                                                                        
                                                               
let skip_leading_continuations s ~start ~end_ =
  let i = ref start in
  while !i < end_ && is_continuation_byte s.[!i] do

let safe_range s ~start ~end_ =
  let start' = skip_leading_continuations s ~start ~end_ in
  let end' =
    let i = ref start' in
    let last_ok = ref start' in
    (try
       while !i < end_ do
         let d = String.get_utf_8_uchar s !i in
         let len = Uchar.utf_decode_length d in
                                                                
                                                                 
                                                                
                                                                        
         if !i + len > end_ then raise Exit
         else begin
           i := !i + len;
           last_ok := !i
         end
       done
     with
    | Exit -> ());
    !last_ok
  in
  (start', end')

                                                                            
                                      
let cp_count s =

  let i = ref 0 in
  let cp_count = ref 0 in
  (try
     while !i < end_ do
       let d = String.get_utf_8_uchar s !i in
       let len = Uchar.utf_decode_length d in
       assert (len >= 1);
       if !i + len > end_ then raise Exit

let is_whitespace = function
  | ' '
  | '\t'
  | '\n'
  | '\r' ->
      true
  | _ -> false

type normalized = { text : string; norm_to_raw : int array }

let normalize_whitespace (raw : string) : normalized =
  let n = String.length raw in
  let buf = Buffer.create n in
  let positions = ref [] in
  let i = ref 0 in
  while !i < n do
    if is_whitespace raw.[!i] then begin
      positions := !i :: !positions;
      Buffer.add_char buf ' ';
      while !i < n && is_whitespace raw.[!i] do
        incr i
      done
    end
    else begin
      positions := !i :: !positions;
      Buffer.add_char buf raw.[!i];
      incr i
    end
  done;
  positions := n :: !positions;
                                                                          
                                                                      
  {
    text = Buffer.contents buf;
    norm_to_raw = Array.of_list (List.rev !positions);
  }

let raw_range_of_normalized (n : normalized) ~start ~end_ =
  (n.norm_to_raw.(start), n.norm_to_raw.(end_))

let sanitize_utf8 s =
  let n = String.length s in
  let start = skip_leading_continuations s ~start:0 ~end_:n in
  let buf = Buffer.create (n - start) in
  (try
     let i = ref start in
     while !i < n do
       let d = String.get_utf_8_uchar s !i in
       let len = Uchar.utf_decode_length d in
       if Uchar.utf_decode_is_valid d then begin
         Buffer.add_substring buf s !i len;
         i := !i + len
       end
       else if !i + len >= n then
                                                                          
                                                                      
                                
         raise Exit
       else begin
         Buffer.add_utf_8_uchar buf Uchar.rep;
         i := !i + len
       end
     done
   with
  | Exit -> ());
  Buffer.contents buf

  let nlen = String.length needle in
  let hlen = String.length haystack in
  let rec loop i =
    if i + nlen > hlen then false

  nlen = 0 || loop 0

### Potential issues

- **P0 — Acknowledged anchors can become outdated without needing review after a move.** Relocation changes `doc_id` but preserves `acknowledged_revision` ([Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:505)). Review status then compares that revision with the *new* document’s revision ([Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:109)). If an anchor acknowledged at revision 10 moves to a document at revision 0, a failed relocation after that document reaches revision 1 is marked outdated but does not need review.

- **P0 — Relocation can silently attach evidence to unrelated text.** The matcher accepts a sufficiently strong text match in another document and applies the first candidate ([Anchor.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/Anchor.ml:483)). An existing test demonstrates an anchor moving to an unrelated copy of shared boilerplate after its original text is replaced ([Text_api_tests.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/tests/Text_api_tests.ml:1096)). The resulting anchor appears up to date despite pointing at unrelated evidence.

- **P1 — Relocation depends on document update order.** Only anchors belonging to the document currently being indexed are retried ([Text.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/Text.ml:199), [DB.ml](/workspace/kb-research/samples/skeletor/skeletor-stripped-comments/base-libs/text/DB.ml:852)). If the original document changes before a new destination is indexed, its anchor fails relocation; adding the destination later does not retry it. The anchor remains outdated until the original document’s revision changes again.
